title: Doesn’t Sync Simultaneously with Fit App
body: It shows the Fit App data, however in doesn’t syncs it. It even shows less than half of the workout/steps done during a day.
author: JanniaPa

title: One star because no iPad app
body: Look I don’t need the iPad to have all the sensors I need to be able to check my health stats without having to bring my phone out. Also in the Apple Watch.
author: Ayrtons63
